method_note: Simulated evidence-constrained portfolio search; no autonomous field, policy, or empirical optimization was executed.

selected_primary_idea.title: CoastWeave: An Equity-Constrained, Climate-Robust Portfolio Model for Land-Sea Coastal Conservation
selected_primary_idea.research_object: A linked watershed-coastal seascape intervention portfolio.
selected_primary_idea.hypothesis: Climate-robust, capacity-gated, equity-constrained portfolios differ materially from ecological-only portfolios.
selected_primary_idea.mechanism: Non-compensatory feasibility/equity gates and scenario robustness prevent aggregate ecological scores from masking distributional or implementation failures.
selected_primary_idea.intervention: A provenance-aware portfolio-selection and abstention framework.
falsification_conditions: No gated and ecological-only portfolio differ.
Climate scenarios do not alter portfolio ranking or minimum performance.
Results are determined solely by undeclared or unbounded assumptions.
contributions: Separate yet linked multi-pressure decision model.

competitive_ideas.title: Plastic leakage and circularity intervention map

rejected_ideas.title: Global single-score ranking
rejected_ideas.reason: Violates contextual, equity, and uncertainty constraints.
